# Parse the old_songs.txt content to extract song titles and artists
content = old_songs_file['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line "# Archived Songs"
old_songs = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artists
        if ' by ' in line:
            title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs:")
for s in old_songs:
    print(f"  Title: {s['title']}, Artists: {s['artists']}")
